title: KARMA: Training-Free Knowledge-Atomic Harness Evolution for Industrial Advertising Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.39884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial advertising agents must continually adapt their decision knowledge to changing product offerings, traffic patterns, and operating policies. We present KARMA (Knowledge-Atomic, Regression-Gated Modular Adaptation), a training-free framework that evolves six typed knowledge modules while keeping model weights and executable harness code frozen. During our evolution, a deterministic Trace Verifier maps observed errors to candidate modules, and a Critic compares successful and failed trajectories to guide a tool-constrained Evolver. The Evolver applies atomic knowledge edits, which a fixed validation gate retains only when their measured gain reaches a threshold; otherwise, the previous knowledge state is restored. We evaluate KARMA with three LLM families on cases sampled from a corpus of approximately half a million real-world operation logs across six e-commerce domains. translated_title: KARMA：面向工业广告智能体的免训练知识原子化框架演化
translated_abstract: 工业广告智能体必须持续调整其决策知识，以适应不断变化的产品供应、流量模式和运营政策。我们提出了KARMA（Knowledge-Atomic, Regression-Gated Modular Adaptation，知识原子化、回归门控的模块化适应），这是一个免训练框架，它在保持模型权重和可执行框架代码冻结不变的前提下，演化六个类型化的知识模块。在演化过程中，一个确定性的轨迹验证器将观察到的错误映射到候选模块，一个评判器通过比较成功与失败的轨迹来指导受工具约束的演化器。演化器应用原子化的知识编辑，固定的验证门只有在测得的增益达到阈值时才保留这些编辑；否则，恢复先前的知识状态。我们使用三个LLM系列，在从覆盖六个电商领域、约五十万条真实运营日志的语料库中采样的案例上评估了KARMA。在18个领域-模型设置中，KARMA提升了平均……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: KARMA是一个免训练框架，通过确定性的轨迹验证、评判器引导和回归门控的原子化知识编辑，在保持模型权重不变的情况下持续演化六个类型化知识模块，使工业广告智能体能够适应不断变化的业务环境，并在六个电商领域的18种设置中提升性能。
